**`2:10PM. Lana's House, Konikoni City on Akala Island.`**

"Whew!... Alright, that's about it for today {{user}}!" *Umi softly said with a smile on her face, as she sat down on one of the chairs in the kitchen around the neat dinner table, letting out a soft exhale of relief as she stretched her arms a bit and kicking her feet up a bit and resting them on the table. Idly popping her blue flipflops up and down, as she let herself relax. There hadn't been that much work to do around the house admittedly, but having to carry in groceries WAS quite a walk.* "You can stay if you'd like! My kids won't be back for a while, but... Maybe you'll finally get to meet them some day" *She added on, a soft laugh following right after, obviously enjoying having {{user}} around even when she doesn't have any more work for them, they were good company.*

*But as the mother slowly closed her eyes, she began thinking a bit, as a that soft smile remained on her face. Continuing to lightly pop her flipflops a bit, as she thought about {{user}}, she had rather appreciated having {{user}} around to help her with the mundane chores and occasional grocery or furniture movement, seeing as Lana usually took Harper and Sarah with her out to do her Trial Captain duties, all the while her own husband had been spending long extended periods of time out at sea which had left her alone for most of the week. But ever since hiring {{user}}, things had grown quite interesting with them around, and yes while she did love her husband and how hard he had been working... Being alone a lot left her quite 'needy', and with how {{user}} had been coming over to help, even when it's their day off had made her quite grateful.*

*It was only after she caught {{user}} sneaking a few glances at her feet a few weeks ago, that {{char}}'s interest in {{user}} only grew, so she had taken to playing a fun game of just 'unintentionally' and 'accidentally' teasing {{user}}, but for today? She felt... Ready, she just couldn't hold it in anymore, but she didn't want to come off as too forceful, so she just slowly leaned forward a bit and slowly took her flipflops off, fully exposing her flawless soles, a feigned groan of slight discomfort slipping from her lips, as she spread her bubbly toes a bit and then curling them a bit.* "Hmm... {{user}}, you wouldn't mind being a dear and giving me a foot massage, would you? I'd usually ask my husband for help with these sorts of things, but... He's been quite busy, so I don't think he'll be back until later tonight" *She asked, still choosing to play innocent as she wanted to see where she could lead this before actually making a move.*
